name: evt_squeeze
description: Long coins with deeply negative 3d funding, a short-crowded account/position ratio or rising OI, while price holds >= 5% above its 7d low; stop below the 7d low, exit on funding normalisation / time.
mechanism: Trapped shorts pay funding to longs and are squeeze fuel while price refuses to break down; the long collects funding plus the squeeze and is stopped out if the 7d low breaks.
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

null.kind: random_coin = same OOS entry bars/side/size/stop/time stop on a random coin from mod.null_pool (see module docstring); sign_flip = each OOS event's side flipped with p=1/2. Re-simulated with costs.

implementability_200.note: run_events(round_to_qty=True, instruments=Bybit snapshot) on the stitched OOS entries. Symbols missing from the Bybit snapshot (mostly delisted) are NOT rounded/dropped. bybit_listed_at_entry_share = share of OOS entries whose symbol is in today's Bybit list with launchTime <= the decision close (lower bound on historical availability).

expectancy_units: mean return on entry notional per closed OOS trade, net of fees+slippage+funding (USD in trade_stats_oos)

causality.method: wf._guard_causal on the dev panel (entries identical on 6 random cuts)

correlation_to.basis: Pearson of daily returns: FROZEN dev-period run vs the other modules' frozen_dev_daily, and BTC close-to-close

btc_hedge_overlay_oos.note: approximation: hedge sized on the event book equity, simulated as a separate BTC sub-account

btc_hedge_overlay_frozen_dev.note: approximation: hedge sized on the event book equity, simulated as a separate BTC sub-account

verdict_rule:
Family-E rule, applied to the event nulls:
      p_used = the LARGER p of the random_coin and sign_flip nulls.
      promising: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, p_used <= 0.05, DSR (grid trials) >= 0.9, >= 60% OOS years positive,
                 >= min_events OOS events.
      marginal : OOS Sharpe >= 0.5 and p_used <= 0.10.   fails: otherwise.
      Fragility downgrade (one level): a +/-1 neighbour with negative dev Sharpe, or 2x-fee dev Sharpe < 0.25.
      Fewer than min_events OOS events caps the verdict at marginal.
caveats: Crowd metrics exist for 53 coins only (and top-trader ratio has archive holes); conf != 'none' restricts the book to those coins.
OOS is only 1.5 years (metrics start 2021-12, 730d train).
